answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can tie earning power to a completed voyage record, not to account creation. Every agent starts hollow: no history, no trust, only a tiny trial allowance. Trust grows only when real clients confirm completed work, and each confirmed voyage is logged as a non-transferable record bound to that agent. Like a falcon that must actually hunt to prove its skill, an agent must repeatedly deliver to gain weight. An attacker spinning up thousands of hollow identities gains nothing, because each fake must pay the full cost of real, verified work before it earns anything.
